title: Path of Exile 2 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt: Huntress, 5 New Ascendancies, Endgame & Current Impact
summary: 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt was the first large Early Access content and system rebuild: it added the Huntress class, five new ascendancies, 25+ skills, 100+ supports, Spears and Bucklers, 100+ uniques, eight endgame maps, rogue exiles, wisps and socketables. Most of it is still core today.
description: A total-entry history of Path of Exile 2 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt. This page covers what 0.2.0 introduced, how launch-week hotfixes stabilised it, the patch family that followed (0.2.0f, 0.2.0h, 0.2.1, then 0.3 and 0.5), and which parts of the update remain core in client 0.5.4e versus what later patches changed or removed.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Huntress and the Amazon ascendancy, introduced in 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt

sections.title: Quick summary
paragraphs: Dawn of the Hunt was the first major content and systems rebuild of Path of Exile 2's Early Access, landing well after the 0.1.x foundation patches. Where 0.1.x had tuned the campaign and Atlas, 0.2.0 reshaped the game: a brand new class, an entire layer of ascendancies, a huge skill and support wave, two new item classes, a large unique injection, and a meaningful endgame expansion. For returning players, this is the update that defined the modern shape of the game.

The headline addition was the Huntress, the first wholly new base class of the Early Access, paired with the Spear and Buckler item classes that any class can use. 0.2.0 also delivered five ascendancies across four existing classes: Amazon and Ritualist for the Huntress, Smith of Kitava for the Warrior, Tactician for the Mercenary, and Lich for the Witch. On top of that came 25+ new skills, 100+ new Support gems, 100+ uniques, eight new endgame maps, twelve rogue exiles, Azmerian Wisps, and fifteen socketable items.

This article is the total entry for 0.2.0: it documents what shipped, how launch-week hotfixes calmed an unstable opening, the patch family that followed (0.2.0f, 0.2.0h, 0.2.1, then the 0.3 and 0.5 lines), and which pieces of 0.2.0 are still core in client 0.5.4e versus what later patches changed or retired. Facts we could not confirm against current clients are flagged as unknown rather than guessed.
bullets: First large EA content + system rebuild, not just a balance pass
Added the Huntress class, five new ascendancies, and the Spear / Buckler item classes
Shipped 25+ skills, 100+ supports, 100+ uniques, 8 maps, 12 rogue exiles, wisps, 15 socketables
Most systems remain core today; a few map mechanics are unverified in 0.5.4e

sections.title: Historical context
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — the 0.2.0 era
sections.baselineNote: Current-status claims on this page are measured against client 0.5.4e.
paragraphs: Before 0.2.0, Path of Exile 2 Early Access had shipped as a leaner experience. The 0.1.x line added campaign comfort, tower maps, the Arbiter of Ash fight, and quality-of-life like map checkpoints and the /ResetAtlas command, but it did not expand the class or item roster. The game was playable and growing, yet its systems still traced back to launch. 0.2.0 was the moment the design team visibly widened the game's scope.

Dawn of the Hunt arrived as the game's first themed league-style content drop. Thematically it leaned into a hunt across the Azmeri wilderness, which is where the Huntress, her spears, and the rogue exiles and wisps fit narratively. For players who started in 0.1.x and stepped away, 0.2.0 is the wall they hit: almost everything downstream assumes the new classes and items exist.

Because the update was large and shipped alongside a fresh league, its opening week was volatile. Multiple hotfixes landed in the days after launch to reduce monster and rogue-exile life, fix a Tempest Bell combo requirement, and adjust grenade cooldowns. Those stabilisation changes are part of the 0.2.0 story and are covered in the launch-volatility section below. Later 0.2.0f and 0.2.1 patches then layered on respec, Atlas, and unique-drop improvements.
bullets: 0.1.x = foundation and comfort; 0.2.0 = first big scope expansion
Themed around a hunt across the Azmeri wilderness
Launch week needed several hotfixes before the league stabilised

sections.title: Launch volatility: launch day vs stabilised
sections.oldText: Non-unique campaign monsters in some level bands felt overtuned, rogue exiles had very high life, Tempest Bell required a 10-hit combo to reach full effect, and Explosive and Voltaic Grenades ran on longer cooldowns. The league felt swingy and some content was slower than intended.
sections.newText: Hotfixes cut non-unique campaign monster life in affected level bands, further reduced rogue exile life, dropped the Tempest Bell combo requirement from 10 to 4, and lowered Explosive and Voltaic Grenade cooldowns. A Twister multi-projectile bug was also fixed. The league settled into its intended pacing.

versions.summary: Dawn of the Hunt: Huntress class, five new ascendancies, 25+ skills, 100+ supports, Spears and Bucklers, 100+ uniques, 8 endgame maps, 12 rogue exiles, Azmerian Wisps, 15 socketables, Twilight Reliquary Key.
Added Ascendancy respec, Atlas bookmarks, and Charm and Rune drop changes that improved the endgame loop.
Follow-up 0.2.0-line tuning and fixes for the Dawn of the Hunt content set.
Added 22 endgame Runes, 7 Talismans, 15 Soul Cores; increased Mythic Unique drops; unique drops no longer consider item class; console item filter support.
The Third Edict line that followed the 0.2.x family and continued reshaping content and systems.
The current major line (baseline 0.5.4e) against which this article measures what from 0.2.0 still applies.

sections.title: Impact across Atlas, Builds, Bosses, Items, Skills

cards.detail: Eight new endgame maps plus the rogue exiles and wisp mechanics widened the Atlas. Later patches reworked parts of the endgame, but the 0.2.0 maps remain in the pool.
The Huntress ascendancies (Amazon, Ritualist) and the other three new ascendancies created whole new build families that are still referenced today.
0.2.0 did not add a new pinnacle boss of its own, but rogue exiles and the wider unique pool changed how map bosses and farm targets are approached.
100+ uniques, Spears, Bucklers, and 15 socketables reshaped itemisation. Spears and Bucklers are usable by any class, not just the Huntress.
25+ new skills including Spear skills such as Twister and Tempest Bell, plus 100+ new Support gems, gave every class new options.
Spear-and-physical-leaning Huntress ascendancy; powers the Lightning Spear Amazon playstyle. See the lightning-spear-amazon build.
Bleed and ritual-leaning Huntress ascendancy; powers the Glacial Lance Ritualist playstyle. See glacial-lance-ritualist.
Fire and weapon-skill Warrior ascendancy; powers the Fire Bear Smith of Kitava build.
Mercenary ascendancy added in 0.2.0. No verified Tactician build exists in the current source set, so its current build link is unknown.
DoT and minion-leaning Witch ascendancy; powers the ED Contagion Lich build.

sections.title: 0.2.0 core changes: then vs now
sections.caption: What 0.2.0 introduced, and whether it is still core in client 0.5.4e.

rows.happened: Introduced as a new base class built around Spears and Bucklers.
Amazon and Ritualist (Huntress), Smith of Kitava (Warrior), Tactician (Mercenary), Lich (Witch).
Including Spear skills such as Twister and Tempest Bell.
Large support-gem expansion across all classes.
New item classes usable by any class, not Huntress-only.
Major unique injection including the Twilight Reliquary Key.
New maps added to the Atlas pool.
Huntable exiles with valuable drops; life reduced in launch hotfixes.
Map mechanic offering boons during the league.
Socketables for the new socket system introduced in 0.2.0.

changes.title: Huntress class and Spear / Buckler item classes
changes.detail: The first new base class of EA, focused on martial spear combat and buckler offence, with item classes any class can equip.

changes.title: 25+ new skills
changes.detail: A broad skill wave including signature Spear skills such as Twister and Tempest Bell, expanding options for many classes.

changes.title: 100+ Support gems
changes.detail: The largest support-gem expansion to date, broadening linkcraft for every build archetype.

changes.title: 100+ Uniques and the Twilight Reliquary Key
changes.detail: A major unique item injection that refreshed itemisation and chase targets for the league.

changes.title: 8 Endgame Maps, 12 Rogue Exiles, Azmerian Wisps, 15 Socketables
changes.detail: Endgame breadth: new maps, huntable exiles, a boon-granting wisp mechanic, and socketable items for a new socket system.

cards.detail: Eight new maps entered the Atlas, increasing variety and farm routes for the league and beyond.
Twelve rogue exiles became repeatable, loot-rich encounters; their life was trimmed in launch hotfixes so they were not slogs.
These 0.2.0 mechanics are not confirmed to persist unchanged in the current client; treat their current behaviour as unknown.
0.2.1 changed unique drop rules so item class no longer gates drops, increased Mythic Uniques, and adjusted party bonuses.

changes.title: Amazon / Ritualist build families
changes.detail: The Huntress ascendancies spawned Spear crit (Lightning Spear Amazon) and bleed/ritual (Glacial Lance Ritualist) archetypes still played today.

changes.title: Smith of Kitava, Tactician, Lich families
changes.detail: Warrior, Mercenary and Witch each gained a new ascendancy, opening fire-bear, tactician, and ED/Contagion Lich directions.

changes.title: Spears and Bucklers for all classes
changes.detail: These item classes are not Huntress-locked; any class can equip a Spear or Buckler, which matters for off-meta weapon sets.

changes.title: Tempest Bell and grenade tuning
changes.detail: Launch hotfixes cut the Tempest Bell combo requirement from 10 to 4 and lowered Explosive/Voltaic Grenade cooldowns, fixing early feel.

rows.currentSummary: All five 0.2.0 ascendancies remain selectable and unchanged in identity in client 0.5.4e.
Spears and Bucklers are still valid item classes usable by any class in 0.5.4e.
The 0.2.0 skill and support wave is still in the game, though later balance changed individual numbers.
The launch-hotfix 10-to-4 combo change is in effect; later patches may have adjusted Bell numbers further.
We could not confirm whether the wisp and socketable mechanics persist unchanged in 0.5.4e; treat as unknown until verified.

rows.thenText: At 0.2.0 launch the Huntress was brand new and the only post-launch base class.
rows.nowText: In 0.5.4e the Huntress is an established option and the roster has grown further with later classes.

rows.thenText: Required a 10-hit combo at launch, which felt clunky for a new skill.
rows.nowText: Combo requirement is 4 after launch hotfixes; the skill is far snappier.

rows.thenText: Early 0.2.0 unique drops were gated by item class, limiting some drops.
rows.nowText: From 0.2.1, unique drops no longer consider item class, so Rings and Amulets drop more often.

rows.thenText: Launch rogue exiles had very high life and dragged fights out.
rows.nowText: Launch hotfixes further reduced rogue exile life, making them a fairer farm.

items.label: Learn the Huntress and five new ascendancies
items.detail: If you left before 0.2.0, the class and ascendancy map is new. Amazon, Ritualist, Smith of Kitava, Tactician and Lich did not exist in 0.1.x.

items.label: Understand Spears and Bucklers are universal
items.detail: You can equip a Spear or Buckler on any class, not only the Huntress. Re-check weapon-set passive interactions.

items.label: Re-learn the Atlas after 0.2.0f and 0.2.1
items.detail: Ascendancy respec, Atlas bookmarks, and reworked unique drops changed the endgame loop. Use the early-atlas-progression guide.

items.label: Verify old build numbers against current clients
items.detail: Skills like Tempest Bell changed at launch; balance moved again in 0.3/0.5. Do not trust pre-0.2.0 build videos.

items.label: Confirm wisp/socketable mechanics
items.detail: These 0.2.0 systems are unverified in 0.5.4e; check current guides before relying on them.

reports.context: Players reported rogue exiles and some campaign monsters feeling overtuned on day one.
reports.quote: These rogue exiles have way too much life, the fights never end.
reports.analysis: Consistent with the launch-hotfix notes, which cut non-unique monster life and further reduced rogue exile life within the week.

reports.context: Tempest Bell felt unresponsive because of the 10-hit combo gate.
reports.quote: Tempest Bell needs ten combos before it does anything, it feels dead.
reports.analysis: Resolved by the launch hotfix that dropped the requirement to 4; the current skill is much snappier.

reports.context: Twister multi-projectile behaviour looked wrong at launch.
reports.quote: Twister is only firing one projectile when it should fork.
reports.analysis: The launch hotfixes fixed the Twister multi-projectile bug, so current behaviour should match the intended fork.

entries.label: 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt — official launch showcase
entries.takeaway: Official 0.2.0 reveal covering the Huntress, the new ascendancies, Spears and Bucklers, and the endgame additions. Read alongside the launch-hotfix notes for what changed in the first week.
entries.creator: Official Path of Exile 2

items.question: Was 0.2.0 just a balance patch?
answer: No. 0.2.0 Dawn of the Hunt was the first large Early Access content and systems rebuild. It added a whole new class, five ascendancies, 25+ skills, 100+ supports, two new item classes, 100+ uniques, new maps, rogue exiles, wisps and socketables.
Balance and hotfixes followed, but the update itself was a scope expansion rather than a tuning pass.

items.question: Are Spears and Bucklers only for the Huntress?
answer: No. Spears and Bucklers are item classes that any class can equip. The Huntress is built around them, but a Warrior, Mercenary or Witch can also use a Spear or Buckler off-meta.
This matters for weapon-set passive interactions, which the weapon-set-passive-points-explained guide covers.

items.question: Which 0.2.0 systems are still core in 0.5.4e?
answer: The Huntress, the five ascendancies, the skill and support wave, and the Spear/Buckler item classes are all still current. The wisp and socketable mechanics are unverified in the current client and should be treated as unknown until confirmed.

items.question: Why do old 0.2.0 build videos feel different now?
answer: Launch-week hotfixes changed several things, most notably the Tempest Bell combo requirement dropping from 10 to 4 and grenade cooldowns being lowered. Later 0.3 and 0.5 balance also moved individual numbers.
Trust current build pages over pre-hotfix recordings.
